content.comment_body: Hello [product_name] Experts, I'm working with a [product_name] controller with article number [article_no] and software version [version_no]. The device responds to network requests, and firmware is version [version_no]. I've selected [product_name] [version_no] while configuring. The device shows as accessible in the network view. Up to this point, everything works. However, when attempting to download the configuration by right-clicking the device and selecting transfer (PC to [product_name]), I receive a popup stating the device is in run mode and asks to switch to stop mode. Regardless of selecting Yes or No, the download doesn't proceed further and no additional popup appears. Assuming the program is somehow downloaded, trying an online test gives an error indicating the program diagram in the device and the PC software are not identical. Can anyone advise what I may be missing? Thanks in advance
Your description of the error is somewhat unclear. It's difficult to determine whether the download actually completes or not.
Are your PC and the [product_name] device in the same IP subnet?
Hi, thanks for replying. To clarify: I'm unable to download. Both PC and [product_name] are on the same IP subnet, and the device responds to pings from the PC.

What are the IP address and subnet mask for the [product_name]? What are the IP address and subnet mask for your PC? Have you configured a gateway address? Are you able to share a screenshot of the connection settings window?

Thanks again, here are the details: Question 1: [product_name] IP: 192.168.217.36 Subnet: 255.255.252.0 Gateway: (not set) Question 2: PC IP: 192.168.216.81 Subnet: 255.255.252.0 Gateway: (not set) Question 3: Gateway isn't configured. Question 4:

The [product_name] device uses a class C network. Its typical IP range is 192.0.0.0 – 223.255.255.255 with subnet mask 255.255.255.0. I'm unsure if your current IP configuration allows successful communication between the [product_name] and PC.
Try changing the [product_name] IP address to: [product_name] IP: 192.168.216.82

analysis.insight_summary: A user tried uploading a program to a [product_name] controller using [product_name] software version [version_no], but encountered issues during transfer. Although network communication appeared successful, the download stalled after a prompt regarding operating modes, and online diagnostics pointed to a mismatch between device and software versions. Forum responses concentrated on verifying and correcting network settings, especially IP address compatibility between the PC and the [product_name] device.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to successfully transfer a configuration from their PC to the [product_name] controller and to perform online diagnostics without obstacles caused by version conflicts or IP network misconfiguration.
